faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Assistant Professor post at Government Engineering College Daman is 09 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Professor position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E/B.Tech in Bio-Medical Engineering and an M.E/M.Tech in Bio-Medical Engineering with First Class or Equivalent in either degree.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to this post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Assistant Professor post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is this a permanent or contract position?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based position for a period of six months.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline by sending the prescribed application format to the Principal, Government Engineering College, Daman.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I find the application form?
faq.answer: The application format is available on the official websites: https://ddd.gov.in/ and www.govtenggcollegedaman.org.in.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number is 1.0-EST-GEC/Volume-III/2026-27/495.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Assistant Professor in Bio-Medical Engineering.
